meta.name: migrate-from-v1
meta.description: Finish migrating a NanoClaw v1 install into v2. Run after `bash migrate-v2.sh` completes. Seeds the owner, migrates legacy memory, reconciles container configs, and helps port custom v1 code. Triggers on "migrate from v1", "finish migration", "v1 migration".

howto.what: 完成NanoClaw v1到v2迁移的最后步骤，包括检查失败步骤、设置所有者角色、迁移遗留内存、调整容器配置、移植自定义代码。

howto.what_en: Finishes migrating a NanoClaw v1 install into v2 by triaging failed steps, seeding the owner role, migrating legacy memory, reconciling container configs, and assisting with porting custom v1 code.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "migrate from v1", "finish migration", or "v1 migration", and requires that the `bash migrate-v2.sh` script has already been run.
